messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high-severity: GPU OOMs detected on runtime-host-23 during prefill phase — 6 container restarts in the last 5m. Auto-fallback triggered to soft-evict mode. Logs: `OOM when allocating tensor of size 3.1GiB`
oncall_elena: saw this spike, paging in. Currently seeing ~12% failed requests and increased tail latency for chat-api v2.
sre_mike: on it — looking at node metrics and kvcache growth. Initial hypothesis: very long system prompts + user message causing prefill to balloon.
runtime_raj: I can throttle prefetching and disable aggressive kv-prefetch for that host. Pushing a canary config: `runtime.prefetch.max_tokens=2048 -> 512`
cust_success_anya: any customer impact to highlight? One enterprise customer reported streaming disconnects ~15:03 UTC. They saw mid-generation errors.
eng_ops_kim: quick mitigation: route new requests for chat-api-v2 away from runtime-host-23 (we have spare capacity in pool-b). I can add a routing rule now.
oncall_elena: please do. Also start a short-term circuit-breaker for requests with prompt_length > 32k tokens. We need to avoid noisy long-prompts.
runtime_raj: routing rule applied. Also toggled `kv_cache.prefetch=false` on host-23 and rolled the container. Will monitor.
sre_mike: logs after restart show fewer prefill allocations but still seeing one outlier request allocating 7GiB. Can we snapshot the offending request payload for root-cause?
cust_success_anya: asking customer for sample request, but we should sanitize before sharing.
eng_ops_kim: temporary patch: apply model-size cap fallback — if prefill estimate > 5GiB, auto-fallback to quantized-compat model (q8). I'll push policy now.
runtime_raj: pushed fallback policy. New requests beyond threshold should route to cpu-coldmodel or q8 variant.
oncall_elena: good. Mike/Kim, please confirm mitigation reduced error rate.
sre_mike: error rate dropped to 1.8% from 12% after routing + kv-prefetch off and fallback policy. Still watching.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty rotation: @oncall_elena is primary, escalation to @sre_mike after 15m if >3 restarts.
oncall_elena: starting handoff to night rotation in 20m — leaving notes: disabled prefetch, applied route to pool-b, enabled q8 fallback, circuit-breaker for >32k tokens, container restarted once. Customer-facing update drafted.
cust_success_anya: submitting customer note: "We observed elevated errors due to unusually long requests; we've mitigations in place and will follow up with sanitized request examples."
eng_ops_kim: follow-up ops items: (1) add per-node prefill-estimator alert, (2) add explicit limit on prefetch token window, (3) add sampling to capture offending payloads to secure S3.
sre_mike: filing postmortem ticket and will include memory flamegraph + kernel OOM stack.
oncall_elena: please include rollback plan for the fallback policy. If q8 fallback degrades quality, we should be able to disable it per-customer.
runtime_raj: noted. I'll add per-tenant opt-out flags.
eng_ops_kim: final status for now: degraded -> partial-recovered. Monitoring 30m. Will update channel on any regressions. :white_check_mark:
